# svg-slides set: Swiss (`swiss`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

International Typographic Style: a strict 12-column grid, one grotesque (Helvetica / Arial) in two weights, flush-left ragged-right type, white content slides framed by bold red colour-block title, statement and closing slides, black rules, no ornament.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set swiss --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- KeynotePro "Geneva" (International Typographic Style theme): bold coloured title and callout slides around clean white content slides, colour reserved for emphasis, minimal geometric ornament.
- Consulting slide rules (deckary.com design guide): three colour roles, 15 to 20 percent whitespace, one margin every element snaps to.

Fonts: head `Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`; sans `Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover (1280x720): a red colour block over the left 70% holds every text slot flush left on the grid; the white right column carries stacked black typographic bars and a red square. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: a heavy black rule across the top margin, an oversized red chapter number in the left four columns, eyebrow, title and orientation line from column six, a thin rule closing the block. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide in reversed type: a solid ink field (black, a lifted charcoal in dark), a red square marks the eyebrow, three flush-left lines of statement, the attribution under a thin rule. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide on the 12-column grid: eyebrow and heading over a heavy black rule with a red tab, body text and a red-ruled key point in the left six columns, a hairline-framed graphic and caption in the right six. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: eyebrow and heading over a heavy black rule, a large graphic slot across nine columns, and a red colour-block column on the right holding the takeaway in white. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: the red colour block fills the slide; an oversized two-line title, a thin white rule, up to three contact lines and a meta line, all flush left; a black bar anchors the bottom right. |
